summary: Settings → Providers and models: the immune system and engineering learning become settable policy flows of the existing R6 write path (/agent/config: CAS on the Gateway config revision, included-cost allowlist, biometric confirmation when an account is added, receipt v2, replay, revert, inherit), primary + at most one fallback, stored in two plugin-config keys (immuneModelFlow, engineeringModelFlow). evidence: Plugin config schema (two policy-flow keys), /agent/config flow values, /providers immune_system and engineering_learning roles.

limitations: Full canonical CI on the final GitHub head remains required.
The setting takes effect once the twin playbooks PR (governor reader) is activated; deploy this core first.
The app (android/samantha, line feature/samantha-ux-c11-20261009) needs its twin PR to edit the two flows.
The immune port (intentInterpreterPort IMMUNE_MODELS) is unchanged: it already admits exactly Sol, Luna and Gemini free.

The playbooks model behaviour gate accepts Sol or Luna only: if Gemini free is set first for the immune system, its next gate run fails closed (auto-apply stays off) until a Sol/Luna setting or « hériter ».
rollback: Inherit (or revert) both policy flows from the app first, so neither immuneModelFlow nor engineeringModelFlow remains in openclaw.json, then revert this PR and redeploy the core. A remaining key would be refused by the previous plugin config schema.
